channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Lebanese who fled Israeli invasion visit to see what's left
item.description: Residents of Nabatiyeh in southern Lebanon have faced wars before, but the latest conflict with Israel is testing their limits.

item.title: FDA weighs new flu shot based on technology RFK Jr. has questioned
item.description: The FDA is set to decide on Moderna's mRNA flu shot, potentially the first of its kind. The decision is expected soon.

item.title: Opinion: Remembering Margo Howard
item.description: Margo Howard, known for her advice column "Dear Prudence" at Slate, passed away this week at age 86. She drew on her rich life experience to guide readers for years.

item.title: How these slum dwellers went from one-room shacks to beautiful new apartments
item.description: An innovative project, already award-winning, lets residents of a crowded slum—many living in tiny tin shacks—help design their new homes.
